title: Paying with planets: both values beside each planet
description: Whenever planets pay for something, each planet now shows both its resource and its influence value right next to it. The payment list used to show only the value being paid with; the map badge showed the other value only for influence payments. The value being paid with is highlighted, the other is dimmed. Before shots are taken on the commit without the change; after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- BX. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.

shots.heading: Before: payment list
shots.caption: Only the value paid with (+2 resources) beside each planet.

shots.heading: After: payment list
shots.caption: Resource and influence value beside every planet; the one paid with is highlighted.

shots.heading: Before: map badges
shots.caption: Resource payment badge shows only resources.

notes.title: Where
notes.text: PaymentDrawer reads printed values from PlanetResourcesContext / PlanetInfluenceContext (static map tiles); StandardOverlay's payment mark shows the other currency too. Token payments already showed both.
